manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Watch a tossed ball rise, stop for an instant at the top, and fall under continuous downward gravity.
manifest.description: A vertical throw scene showing a ball rising and falling. A blue velocity arrow shortens as the ball ascends, vanishes at the peak, and reverses pointing down during descent. A warm acceleration arrow consistently points downward throughout the throw.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows. Press Play again to watch the ball fall, or drag the timeline to inspect any moment.
